Anthropic says Claude doesn't silently sabotage work and that some user reports reflect “overcaution”, where Claude clings to self-imposed rules on long tasks   —  Claude has not been trained to sabotage work. Yes, it sometimes makes mistakes, and other agents might identify them, but this isn't sabotage. There have been a few screenshots floating around of an outdated Fable 5 system card.
